-- NE Governor: Lynne Walz (D) wins primary, Jim Pillen (R) wins primary
UPDATE governor_races
SET dem_candidate = 'Lynne Walz',
    primary_winner = 'Lynne Walz',
    primary_party = 'D'
WHERE state_name = 'Nebraska';

-- Verify WV Senate update worked
SELECT state_name, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status, primary_winner
FROM senate_races WHERE state_name IN ('West Virginia', 'Nebraska');
